responsibility: Implements the backend-tree-based Rust unused-variable lint. Instead of traversing Rust HIR, it walks GCC tree declarations gathered in Compile::Context—function parameters, local variables in saved trees, generated variable expressions, and const declarations—and emits the appropriate GCC warning options for unused VAR_DECL, PARM_DECL, and CONST_DECL nodes while honoring artificial declarations and underscore-prefixed names.
same_name_distinction: Contains the concrete backend-tree lint logic behind the header’s single entry point: it walks GCC DECL trees from Compile::Context, checks TREE_USED/DECL_ARTIFICIAL and underscore-prefixed names, and emits unused-variable or unused-const warnings.
